summary: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V3, a 671B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model (37B activated per token) trained on 14.8T tokens using MLA and DeepSeekMoE architectures, requiring 2.788M H800 GPU hours, with checkpoints released publicly.

mechanisms.reason: The model architecture is explicitly designed to reduce compute and memory needed per token via sparse activation and latent attention.
mechanisms.quote: To achieve efficient inference and cost-effective training, DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, which were thoroughly validated in DeepSeek-V2.

mechanisms.reason: A frontier-class 671B parameter model was trained with a strikingly low disclosed GPU-hour figure, indicating less training compute is needed to reach top-tier performance than prior scaling would suggest.
mechanisms.quote: Despite its excellent performance, DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.

mechanisms.reason: The MoE architecture carries a very large total parameter count that must reside in memory even though only a fraction is activated per token, increasing memory footprint per accelerator.
mechanisms.quote: a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token.

mechanisms.reason: An open-source model is claimed to reach parity with leading closed-source frontier models at a fraction of the disclosed training cost, a step change in the cost-capability frontier.
mechanisms.quote: Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models.

practices.reason: A frontier-comparable open-weight model trained with unusually low disclosed GPU hours and stable training changes what is worth self-hosting versus buying from closed providers.
practices.quote: Despite its excellent performance, DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.

practices.reason: MLA and DeepSeekMoE are architectural techniques for reducing inference cost that a team building its own models could evaluate, though the results are tied to DeepSeek's own training stack.
practices.quote: DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, which were thoroughly validated in DeepSeek-V2.

practices.reason: Public checkpoint availability means teams could self-host the model, creating potential integration and evaluation work.
practices.quote: The model checkpoints are available at this https URL .

notable_reason: A frontier-comparable open-weight MoE model trained with unusually low disclosed GPU-hours is a direct data point on training and inference cost efficiency relevant to compute demand forecasts.
